requires_runtime.browser: optional — only if the `playwright` MCP server is enabled. An installed Edge, Chrome, Firefox or WebKit; nothing is bundled. Not needed on hosts with built-in browser tools (VS Code Copilot).
requires_runtime.notes: The bundled mcp.json invokes `npx -y flint-chart-mcp@^0.2.2` on first tool call; Node 22+ required. First cold start ~1-2s; cached thereafter. Install it to `.vscode/mcp.json` — VS Code does NOT read a workspace-root `.mcp.json`, which is the Claude Code convention; the `servers` schema is identical, and VS Code reports no error because it reads no file at all. The ^0.2.2 pin is held deliberately: caret on 0.x means >=0.2.2 <0.3.0, and although public npm `latest` is 0.4.0, that version is unreachable from Microsoft corporate npm mirrors, which stop at 0.2.2. mcp.json also declares an OPTIONAL second server, `playwright`, used only by the render-verify skill on hosts with no browser of their own — chiefly GitHub Copilot CLI. VS Code heirs should omit that entry.

upstream.notes: Source-of-truth is the upstream OSS repo. Mall vendors a specific version; when upstream tags a new release, Mall automation flags the mismatch.

servers.role: satisfies the render-verify skill's browser capability on hosts with none of their own — chiefly GitHub Copilot CLI, a terminal agent with no browser
servers.omit_when: The host already has built-in browser/screenshot tools. VS Code Copilot does: it opens file:// with no flags and no browser download. Omit this entry there.
servers.security: --allow-unrestricted-file-access is REQUIRED for file:// navigation, which the server blocks by default. It grants the browser read access to any file the user can read — acceptable for verifying local artifacts, NOT safe combined with browsing untrusted web pages.
servers.browser: No bundled browser; Playwright drives an installed one by channel. msedge is shipped because it ships with Windows, where most heirs are; override with chrome/firefox/webkit elsewhere.

mcp.notes: VS Code workspace path is `.vscode/mcp.json`. Root `.mcp.json` is the Claude Code convention and is never read by VS Code; Cursor uses `.cursor/mcp.json`; GitHub Copilot CLI uses `~/.copilot/mcp-config.json` with top-level key `mcpServers`, not `servers`. Merge entries into the existing server map — overwriting the file destroys the user's other servers.

install_notes: Skills and prompts install under `local/`, which VS Code does not discover by default. Alex ACT Edition heirs (>=3.0.0, per requires_edition) already register those roots, so no extra settings are needed for a Mall install. On a plain VS Code workspace, `chat.agentSkillsLocations` and `chat.promptFilesLocations` must additionally point at `.github/skills/local` and `.github/prompts/local` — see the upstream README.

attribution.role: invoked via npx on first tool call
optional; invoked via npx only when the playwright entry is enabled

schema_notes: First Mall plugin with an MCP artifact. Shape code retained as .SP. (skill + prompt) since the current 4-position shape [I][S][P][M=muscle] does not have an MCP position. If Mall extends shape to 5 positions for MCP, bump this plugin to `.SPM.` (or agreed-upon convention).
